script_text: Aquarius, this week is no reset; Uranus, your ruling planet, occupies your 4th House as Saturn, your traditional ruler, stations retrograde in your 2nd House. Early week, Venus in Gemini in your 5th House conjuncts the Sun, then Tuesday's New Moon in Gemini sextiles Jupiter in Cancer, your 6th House, boosting romance. Tuesday is best for love or income. Wednesday is worst: Mars in Aries in your 3rd House squares Jupiter in your 6th House, so emails and errands cost. Midweek, Saturn stations retrograde at 21° Pisces in your 2nd House, auditing money habits. Audit your budget before purchases. Thursday into Sunday, your Air element steadies as Mercury in Cancer in your 6th House trines Saturn, improving client flow and teamwork. Weekend Moon in Leo, your 7th House, opposes Pluto in your 1st House, so choose partners who respect your autonomy. Follow for daily updates.
